translations.web: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
translations.bsb: When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.
translations.kjv: And when he putteth forth his own sheep, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.
translations.asv: When he hath put forth all his own, he goeth before them, and the sheep follow him: for they know his voice.
